title: Clothing
html:
For the decorative equipment that is used while in camp, see Camp Clothing.

Clothing is a form of Equipment that provides no additional protection against damage, but allows classes with no armour proficiency (like Sorcerer and Wizard) to cast Spells in combat.

When wearing clothing, your Armour Class is equal to 10 plus your Dexterity Modifier. Also, since it is not classified as armour, all the spells and equipment with the condition "While you are not wearing any armour" such as Mage Armour still fully function while wearing them.
